patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column content blocks, often featuring a large, high-quality image on one side and descriptive text on the other, with the image-text pairing alternating sides down the page.
Prominent use of a very large, bold sans-serif typeface for the main brand name and section titles, establishing a strong visual hierarchy and editorial feel.
A minimalist palette dominated by black text on a white background, with sparse, deliberate use of a warm orange/red accent for bullet points and subtle highlights.

A sticky header that transforms by shrinking in height and gaining a solid background on scroll, combined with scroll-triggered reveals where content sections slide up and fade in as they enter the viewport.
Content sections are clearly delineated by large, bold headings and consistently feature a large, high-quality image paired with concise descriptive text, often with a 'More' link.

technique_notes: The header element is initially large and transparent, then uses a CSS keyframe animation to shrink in height and become a sticky, smaller navigation bar with a solid background as the user scrolls past the initial hero content.

Content blocks and individual elements within sections are revealed using scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations, causing them to slide up from below and fade into full opacity as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Massive, bold display headings (~10x body) for the brand name, large bold section headings (~2-3x body), standard body text, and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content sections and within the hero area, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's distinctive use of its brand name 'PARDON' as a monumental, almost architectural, graphic element in the hero section, combined with an editorial layout and high-quality, art-focused photography, elevates it beyond a typical corporate site. It feels more like a curated publication or gallery.
